title: Removing 1 Piece Until I BEAT Magnus
summary: Tony plays the Magnus bot removing one Magnus piece per game, starting with a rook. He wins the very first game (Magnus minus one rook) via a king-and-pawn endgame, promoting twice and finishing with a ladder mate.
rules: Magnus bot starts without one rook.
